repositories.name: Synex_Framework
repositories.description: ⚡ **Synex** — A modern, modular & extensible FiveM framework built for performance, scalability and clean development. Powered by a robust core and a growing ecosystem of official resources — from characters, inventory & banking to phones, radio, vehicles, jobs and beyond.

repositories.name: DXForge
repositories.description: DXForge is a DX9 Lua UI library focused on building customizable in-game overlay interfaces with draggable windows, tabs, groupboxes, buttons, toggles, sliders, keybinds, color pickers, notifications, tooltips, themes, and reusable UI components.
